game_desc: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Alchemical Fire
description: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing Spirit Damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. {s:NonHeroReductionPercent}% less effective vs non-heroes.
game_desc: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing Spirit Damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. {s:NonHeroReductionPercent}% less effective vs non-heroes.

name: Ballistic Enchantment
description: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.
game_desc: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

name: Berserker
description: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.
game_desc: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

name: Blood Tribute
description: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve Fire Rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
game_desc: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve Fire Rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

name: Burst Fire
description: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.
game_desc: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

name: Cultist Sacrifice
description: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for {s:BonusSoulsPct}% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
game_desc: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for {s:BonusSoulsPct}% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

name: Escalating Resilience
description: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.
game_desc: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

name: Express Shot
description: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
game_desc: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

name: Headhunter
description: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals Weapon Damage, Healing you, and briefly grants Move Speed.
game_desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals Weapon Damage, Healing you, and briefly grants Move Speed.

name: Heroic Aura
description: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. Provides Move Speed and Fire Rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.
game_desc: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. Provides Move Speed and Fire Rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

name: Hollow Point
description: When you are above {s:LifeThreshold}% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.
game_desc: When you are above {s:LifeThreshold}% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

name: Hunter's Aura
description: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.
game_desc: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

name: Point Blank
description: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.
game_desc: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

name: Shadow Weave
description: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
game_desc: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
game_desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Spirit Rend
description: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.Passive: Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.
game_desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.Passive: Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

name: Tesla Bullets
description: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.
game_desc: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

name: Toxic Bullets
description: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.
game_desc: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

name: Weighted Shots
description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
game_desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Armor Piercer
description: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
game_desc: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

name: Capacitor
description: Launch a projectile that deals Spiritdamage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
game_desc: Launch a projectile that deals Spiritdamage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

name: Crippling Headshot
description: Passive: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.
game_desc: Passive: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

name: Crushing Fists
description: Your Melee Damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
game_desc: Your Melee Damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

name: Frenzy
description: Passive: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
game_desc: Passive: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of {s:MaxStacks} times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
game_desc: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of {s:MaxStacks} times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

name: Lucky Shot
description: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.
game_desc: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

name: Ricochet
description: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.
game_desc: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

name: Silencer
description: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for {s:ImmunityDuration}s after silence expires.
game_desc: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for {s:ImmunityDuration}s after silence expires.

name: Spellslinger
description: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.
game_desc: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

name: Spiritual Overflow
description: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
game_desc: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
